title: 40 made ni Shitai 10 no Koto
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Office worker Suzume Tojo, three months from turning forty, writes a secret list of simple things he wants to do, such as a takoyaki party and a parfait at a cafe, plus spending his birthday with a lover. His handsome junior colleague Keishi Tanaka finds the list and sets out to help, starting with the lover item (MU, Seven Seas via ANN). This AniList entry is a one-chapter special set the day after the final chapter: Tojo's first morning and first Christmas at forty (AniList).
life_message: It is never too late for small joys and for love.
